Since AB=2a, MF=y_M, and ON²=x_N²+y_N², this is exactly the requested formula. The divisions are valid under the hypotheses: acute NAB gives −a<x_N<a; scalene gives x_N≠0 and excludes the vertical radical-axis case; M closer than N on the same radical axis implies |x_M|<|x_N|, so x_M≠±a; and y_M,y_N>0.
